# livekit_api_keys (Data Source)

The API keys of a project, oldest first, without their secrets and without the keys of cloud agents. Useful to pick a webhook's `signing_key`, or to audit which keys exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "livekit_api_keys" "all" {}

# Keys that belong to a user rather than to the project, which stop working
# when that user leaves it.
output "user_owned_keys" {
  value = [for k in data.livekit_api_keys.all.keys : k.id if !k.service_account]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project (`p_...`). Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) The keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the key was created.
- `description` (String) The key's label.
- `id` (String) The API key (`API...`).
- `owner_email` (String) Email of the key's owner; null for a service account key.
- `service_account` (Boolean) Whether the key has no owner and belongs to the project.
